// diagnostic

E0757

A library effect's `#FX(…)` list denies an effect

What

A library effect's `#FX(…)` list denies an effect

Why

The list above a library effect names the kernel effects it relies on, so it holds no `!` entries

Fix

Remove the `!` entry; a function that must not use that effect denies it in its own row

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0757: tests/ui/effects/library_effect_list_denial_is_e0757.stderr.

Error [jet.LibraryEffectListDenial]: The `#FX(…)` above the library effect `Query` denies `FS`
  --> tests/ui/effects/library_effect_list_denial_is_e0757.jet:1:10
    |
  1 | #FX(Net, !FS)
    |          ^^^
 Why: The list above a library effect names the kernel effects it relies on, so it holds no `!` entries
 Fix: Remove `!FS`; a caller that must not use `FS` writes `-[!FS]>` itself
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0757
